description: Keyed-edge-removal direction selector defaulting: any value other than the exact string directed (missing key, uppercase variant, or boolean type) falls back to the undirected reverse-order removal branch.

input.scenario: direction key absent -> default undirected branch

cases.expected_output:
direction=undirected
before_1_to_2=-1
before_2_to_1=-1
before_neighbors_of_1=1
remove_missing=missing
remove_existing_reverse=-1
after_edges=0
after_1_to_2=missing
after_2_to_1=missing
after_neighbors_of_1=0

input.scenario: uppercase DIRECTED is not an exact match so undirected branch runs

cases.expected_output:
direction=undirected
before_1_to_2=-1
before_2_to_1=-1
before_neighbors_of_1=1
remove_missing=missing
remove_existing_reverse=-1
after_edges=0
after_1_to_2=missing
after_2_to_1=missing
after_neighbors_of_1=0

input.scenario: boolean direction coerces to empty and defaults to undirected

cases.expected_output:
direction=undirected
before_1_to_2=-1
before_2_to_1=-1
before_neighbors_of_1=1
remove_missing=missing
remove_existing_reverse=-1
after_edges=0
after_1_to_2=missing
after_2_to_1=missing
after_neighbors_of_1=0
